My 11-year old son to his dad while discussing (again) #BlackLivesMatter and #GeorgeFloyd: “Why are people only listening now? What if there weren’t cameras there?” This right here might be the thing that breaks me today.

“The revolution has always been in the hands of the young. The young always inherit the revolution.” —Huey P. Newton #blacklivesmatter✊🏾 #Repost @flattopphotography ・・・
America, y’all hear us now? We’re black and we’re proud ✊🏾🖤
